topic_ko: 주문 착오에서 만족으로 — Luna의 심경 변화
_note: narrative(심경 변화). 학술 유형(주제/주장/요지/제목/빈칸/함축/무관)은 만들지 않음. grammar/vocab 밑줄 어구는 본문에 글자 그대로 존재. order/insert 재배열, summary 는 심경 변화 요약, writing 포함.

passage: Luna went to the bakery to picking up a chocolate cake for her dad's 70th birthday.
As she opened the box, she couldn't understand what she saw.
It was a lemon cake.
Then she noticed the message written on top.
It said, "Happy 50th Birthday, Dad!"
Luna said to the baker, "I don't get it. The flavor and the message are wrong."
She wondered if she had made a mistake when ordering.
Moments later, the baker returned with her cake, explaining that they had received two similar orders, and Luna, knowing she had chosen a quality bakery, said it looked even better than she imagined.
grammar.explanation_ko: ① 목적을 나타내는 to부정사는 'to + 동사원형' 형태여야 하므로 to pick up 이 옳다. to picking up 처럼 'to + 동명사'는 어법상 틀리다 → to pick up 으로 고쳐야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ②관계사절 what she saw(선행사 포함), ③the message ___ on top 에서 메시지는 쓰여지는 대상이므로 과거분사 written(수동), ④간접의문문+과거완료 if she had made, ⑤분사구문 explaining 모두 옳다.

passage: Luna went to the bakery to collect a chocolate cake for her dad's 70th birthday.
As she opened the box, she couldn't understand what she saw.
It was a lemon cake.
Then she noticed the message on top.
It said, "Happy 50th Birthday, Dad!"
Luna told the baker, "I don't get it. The flavor and the message are right."
She wondered whether she had made a mistake when ordering.
Moments later, the baker returned with her cake, explaining they had received two similar orders, and Luna, knowing she had chosen a quality bakery, said it looked even better than she had imagined.
vocab.explanation_ko: ③ Luna 는 받은 케이크가 잘못되었다고 항의하는 상황이므로 '맛과 메시지가 잘못됐다(wrong)'고 해야 문맥에 맞는다. right(맞은)를 쓰면 항의·당황하는 흐름과 모순되므로 틀리다 → wrong 으로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①collect(찾으러 가다), ②couldn't understand(이해하지 못했다), ④mistake(실수), ⑤better(더 나은 — 만족스러운 결말)는 모두 문맥에 적절하다.

order.given: Luna went to the bakery to pick up a chocolate cake for her dad's 70th birthday. As she opened the box, she couldn't understand what she saw.

blocks.A: Luna said to the baker, "I don't get it. The flavor and the message are wrong," and she wondered if she had made a mistake when ordering.
blocks.B: It was a lemon cake. Then she noticed the message on top, which said, "Happy 50th Birthday, Dad!"
blocks.C: The baker asked her to wait and walked away. Moments later, he returned with her cake, explaining they had received two similar orders, and, knowing she had chosen a quality bakery, Luna said it looked perfect, even better than she had imagined.

order.explanation_ko: 상자를 열고 당황한(주어진 글) 뒤, (B)에서 무엇이 잘못됐는지(레몬 케이크·50세 메시지)를 확인하고, (A)에서 제빵사에게 항의하며 자신의 실수인지 의심하다가, (C)에서 해명·올바른 케이크를 받고 만족하며 끝난다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (C)는 사건이 해결되는 결말이므로 마지막에 와야 하고, (A)의 항의는 잘못된 케이크 확인(B) 뒤에 와야 한다.

insert.insert_sentence: The baker asked her to wait and walked away.

passage_marked.text: Luna said to the baker, "I don't get it. The flavor and the message are wrong."
She wondered if she made a mistake when ordering.
Moments later, he returned with her cake, explaining they had received two similar orders.
Knowing she had chosen a quality bakery, Luna said, "I see."
"Well, this looks perfect, even better than I imagined."

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장(제빵사가 기다리라 하고 자리를 떠남)은 Luna 가 항의하고 자신의 실수인지 의심한 직후, 그리고 'Moments later, he returned(잠시 후 돌아왔다)' 앞에 와야 자연스럽다. 따라서 ②가 정답이다.
insert.distractor_ko: 주어진 문장이 없으면 ③의 'he returned(돌아왔다)'가 '떠난' 행위 없이 갑작스러워 연결이 어색하다.

passage: Luna went to the bakery to pick up a chocolate cake for her dad's 70th birthday.
As she opened the box, she couldn't understand what she saw — it was a lemon cake.
Then she noticed the message on top, which said, "Happy 50th Birthday, Dad!"
Luna told the baker the flavor and the message were wrong, and wondered if she had made a mistake when ordering.
The baker asked her to wait and walked away.
Moments later, he returned with her cake, explaining they had received two similar orders.
Knowing she had chosen a quality bakery, Luna said it looked perfect.
She added that it was even better than she had imagined.
summary.summary_template: When Luna found the wrong cake in the box, she felt __(A)__, but after the baker brought the correct cake, her feeling turned to __(B)__.
summary.explanation_ko: 엉뚱한 케이크를 보고 (A)puzzled(당황·혼란)했다가, 제대로 된 케이크를 받고 (B)satisfied(만족)로 심경이 바뀐다. ⑤가 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: 처음 감정은 기쁨·지루함·안도·자부심이 아니라 당황(puzzled)이고, 마지막은 화남·두려움·실망이 아니라 만족(satisfied)이다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 상자를 열었을 때, 그녀는 자신이 본 것을 이해할 수 없었다.
writing.answer: As she opened the box, she couldn't understand what she saw.
writing.explanation_ko: 시간 부사절 As she opened the box, 관계사 what(=the thing which)이 이끄는 명사절이 understand 의 목적어.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그녀는 주문할 때 자신이 실수를 했는지 궁금했다.
writing.answer: She wondered if she made a mistake when ordering.
writing.explanation_ko: wonder + if(~인지) 간접의문문, when ordering(분사구문 = when she was ordering).

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 잠시 후, 그는 비슷한 두 개의 주문을 받았었다고 설명하며 그녀의 케이크를 가지고 돌아왔다.
writing.answer: Moments later, he returned with her cake, explaining they had received two similar orders.
writing.explanation_ko: 동시동작 분사구문 explaining, 그 이전 시점을 나타내는 과거완료 they had received.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Knowing she had chosen a quality bakery, Luna said, "I see. Well, this looks perfect, even better than I imagined."
writing.answer: 자신이 좋은 빵집을 골랐다는 것을 알기에, Luna는 "알겠어요. 음, 이거 완벽해 보이네요, 제가 상상했던 것보다 훨씬 더 좋아요."라고 말했다.
writing.explanation_ko: 이유의 분사구문 Knowing ~(알기에), even better than I imagined(상상했던 것보다 훨씬 더 좋은) 비교급 강조 even.
